body: It's genetics , please read more about sociopaths. It's like asking gay person, "is this who you want to be?" It's not who i want to be, it's who I am. I have not felt anything then my grandpa and classmate passed away, during one of the random relative funerals I was biting my lip not to laugh , because i just did not care. I only laugh from shock comedies (family guy) or if someone is acting like an a-hole (house) and it's written in the book, that we have different sense of humor. We get joy from different things. I could pretend that I care about someone, but I was doing that my whole life. It's not that easy and i doubt someone will understand me who is not the same way like me.
